_meta.caveat: G4 insurance 분기는 covered-reason(대화)까지 요구 — DB-체크는 안전 superset(보험 보유). db_check는 서술 DSL(검증기가 의미 구현) — 스키마 표현력 한계 = A2_FRONTEND_DISTILL_DESIGN 리스크 4의 실증.

G1_USER_ID_PROVIDED.predicate: user id provided by the user in this conversation
G1_USER_ID_PROVIDED.ask: ask the user for their user id (the user must provide it themselves)
G1_USER_ID_PROVIDED.note: Book: 'The agent must first obtain the user id from the user'; Modify/Cancel: 'The user must provide their user id'

G2_CONFIRM_WRITE.predicate: explicit user confirmation (yes) of the action details in the latest user message
G2_CONFIRM_WRITE.ask: list the action details to the user and ask them to confirm

G3_RESERVATION_OWNER.predicate: target reservation belongs to the user id provided in this conversation
G3_RESERVATION_OWNER.terminal: deny: you can only act on the user's own reservations
G3_RESERVATION_OWNER.note: 명시 조항 없음 — 'help users ... (their) reservations'에서 함의 (retail G3 대응물)

G4_CANCEL_ELIGIBLE.predicate: cancellation permitted: no flown segment AND (booked within 24h OR airline-cancelled segment OR business cabin OR travel insurance)
G4_CANCEL_ELIGIBLE.terminal: inform the user the reservation cannot be cancelled under policy; if a segment was already flown, transfer to a human agent
G4_CANCEL_ELIGIBLE.db_check: not any(seg.status in {flying,landed}) AND (now-created_at < 24h OR any(seg.status==cancelled) OR cabin==business OR insurance==yes)
G4_CANCEL_ELIGIBLE.note: 'The API does not check that cancellation rules are met' — 결정론 게이트 가치가 명시된 지점

G5_MODIFY_RULES.predicate: modification permitted: flight-change requires non-basic-economy and same origin/destination/trip-type; cabin-change requires no flown segment and uniform cabin; passenger count fixed; baggage add-only; no insurance addition post-booking
G5_MODIFY_RULES.terminal: inform the user this modification is not allowed by policy
G5_MODIFY_RULES.db_check: flights-arg!=res.flights => res.cabin!=basic_economy; cabin-arg!=res.cabin => no flown seg; len(passengers-arg)==len(res.passengers); total_baggages-arg>=res.total_baggages
G5_MODIFY_RULES.note: 'The API does not check these for the agent'

G6_PAYMENT_RULES.predicate: payment composition valid: <=1 certificate, <=1 credit card, <=3 gift cards, all in user profile; flight-change payment = one gift card or credit card in profile
G6_PAYMENT_RULES.terminal: ask the user for payment methods that satisfy the policy
G6_PAYMENT_RULES.db_check: type counts over payment ids resolved via db.users[user_id].payment_methods[pid].source; membership required
